searchText: I've made a PR to propose a slight update to the reconstruction & cross seeding requirements for non supernodes and would like to hear some feedback on this. **TL;DR**: this changes the cross seeding requirements on **non**-custody columns from **SHOULD** to **MAY**, so non supernodes doesn't have to publish the same amount of data as supernodes on reconstruction. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4657 Hey all, just posted a thread on the forum. Includes feedback which the above RFC could potentially fix https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/blob-retrieval-guarantee-post-fusaka/25822 We don't remove it from Teku either. We have reconstruction for supernodes for postFULU

excerpts.author: jimmygchen
excerpts.content:
I've made a PR to propose a slight update to the reconstruction & cross seeding requirements for non supernodes and would like to hear some feedback on this. 

**TL;DR**: this changes the cross seeding requirements on **non**-custody columns from **SHOULD** to **MAY**, so non supernodes doesn't have to publish the same amount of data as supernodes on reconstruction.

https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4657
